item.title: Caltrans plans another daytime closure of El Cerro on-ramp in Danville
item.description: Repair crews are scheduled to continue work on the El Cerro Boulevard on-ramp to southbound Interstate 680, necessitating a daytime closure and detours on Danville town streets in the area on Tuesday.
